allies.name: Horse
allies.description: A loyal mount. Use Feed horse before moving to gain +1 movement this turn.

allies.name: Princess
allies.description: A noble ally with arcane intuition.

allies.name: Mule
allies.description: A sturdy pack animal that increases your carrying capacity by 4.

allies.name: Zombie
allies.description: A shambling undead ally. Grants +1 STR, consumes 1 food each turn (or you lose 1 HP), and can be dismissed with Eliminate zombie.
